name: Happy Valley
summary:
Welcome to Happy Valley, an immersive virtual reality experience designed to make movement engaging, motivating, and fun.

Happy Valley combines  exercises with interactive gameplay to encourage upper body movement, cervical mobility, coordination, motor planning, endurance, and cognitive engagement. Set in a vibrant world filled with colorful characters and playful environments, users can participate in a variety of activities that challenge both body and mind.

Explore 16 modules that focus on:
